title: Long Way Cap

rows.label: Adjustment
rows.value: Adjustable adult fit; no measured size range

care: Loosen the back adjustment before putting the cap on, then tighten it a little at a time. It should sit securely without pressing at your temples. Compare with a cap you already wear; an adult-size label is not a measurement.
Spot clean the canvas with cool water and a little mild soap. Reshape the crown and air dry away from direct heat. Do not machine dry.
A brim provides shade, not a protection rating. This design has no tested UPF claim; plan separate sun protection for time outside.
